# aVenco is a women-majority-owned North American converter of parchment paper rolls and an expert
# in sourcing and distributing sustainable and innovative packaging for private-label brands

Our Customers 

Our customers are retailers with powerful private label brands, committed to optimizing costs
without compromising exceptional quality and dedicated to minimizing their ecological footprint.


Our customers are also distributors and wholesalers looking for a local partner that can offer a
brand and service of excellence for their packaging needs. For them, Avenco has developed
MyParchment™, a unique range of parchment paper rolls.

greaseproof paper and plastic-coated packaging with compliant, scalable paper-based barrier
materials.

* **[PFAS-Free Barrier Paper][17]** for grease-resistant food wrappers, liners, trays, and takeaway
  packaging.
* **[Water-Based Barrier Coating Paper][18]** for recyclable paper cups, food service boards, and
  oil-resistant paper applications.
* **[PHA Coated Paper][19]** for compostable and bio-based barrier packaging projects.

## Typical applications

Paper cups, lunch boxes, burger wrappers, sandwich wraps, bakery packaging, greaseproof liners,
medical packaging paper, and industrial specialty paper.

### Our Solutions

Walls & Ceilings

Roofs

Flooring

Explore our wide range of flooring solutions, including durable OSB and Plywood subfloor products,
as well as a reliable tile backer option. Designed to provide stability and support, our products
are here to help you build a strong foundation for your design.

[Learn More][108]
Lumber

Our company was founded on lumber back in 1927, but it’s what we offer today that makes our lumber
such a trusted choice. See our variety of grades and sizes in our strong and versatile Southern
Yellow Pine.

[Learn More][109]
Industrial & OEM

Whether it’s providing the foundation to furniture or offering the rich, traditional look of
expensive beadboard planking, our specialty products are versatile for furniture, shelving, porch
ceilings, soffits, and more.

[Learn More][110]

### Featured Products

From commercial roofing systems to building envelope protection and interior tile applications, our
products deliver solutions designed to perform in real-world conditions. Explore materials
engineered to help crews work efficiently while supporting long-term durability and protection

## Choose an option below:

DensDeck® Roofboard

The Portfolio of DensDeck® Roof Boards offers high-performance solutions to help protect commercial
low-slope roofs from fire, wind, puncture, and hail.
[Learn More →][111]

DensElement® Barrier System

The DensElement® Barrier System combines efficiency with high performance to help achieve faster
dry-in—all while mitigating installation risks.
[Learn More →][112]

DensShield® Tile Backer

The first tile backer board featuring a built in moisture barrier, DensShield® Tile Backer is
designed for use as a substrate for tile walls, ceilings, countertops and commercial and residential
floor applications in high moisture areas.

production management, we balance quality and environmental responsibility. Our products mainly use
traceable virgin pulp from sustainably managed forests. We also use recycled pulp for some products,
promoting resource circularity.

[ [Who We Are – China Paper] ][134]

China Paper, established in 2000, is a leading Chinese manufacturer and global supplier of
high-quality, sustainable paper products. As a premier China paper factory, we offer a comprehensive
range including **industrial, printing, packaging, and household paper**, serving diverse industry
needs.



With advanced production facilities, strict quality control, and a reliable supply chain, our
products are exported to **Europe, South America, Africa, and Central Asia**. We provide both
standard and customized solutions based on performance and application requirements. Being a
dedicated paper manufacturer in China, we ensure that our production processes meet international
standards.



Committed to quality, innovation, and sustainability, China Paper continues to deliver greener,
reliable products to the global market.

About company

## About company

Our company, **CORNiCO**, offers goods and services in the gastronomy sector. We supply products and
services to Fun Food and Fast Food establishments. We are a Slovak company founded in 1991. In the
beginning, we sold popcorn on the street, which gave us extensive experience across various levels
of gastronomy. Step by step, we built up our business activities. Later, we established a trading
company and wholesale warehouse offering specialized machinery, equipment, and products in the
Central European region.

beginning, we sold popcorn on the street, which gave us extensive experience across various levels
of gastronomy. Step by step, we built up our business activities. Later, we established a trading
company and wholesale warehouse offering specialized machinery, equipment, and products in the
Central European region.

Explore the world’s knowledge, cultures, and ideas Explore the world’s knowledge, cultures, and
ideas
* [Detail of an Indian miniature painting depicting Krishna, a blue-skinned figure in a crown and
  yellow garments, seated on a platform reading a letter inviting him to a svayamvara (marriage
  ceremony). A messenger in white robes stands before him in reverence, while an attendant with a
  staff stands in an alcove to the left. The scene is set against a vibrant red background within an
  architectural frame.]
* [Detail of an impressionistic painting by Ion Bitan titled "Landscape from Bucharest," featuring a
  person in a red hooded coat standing before two red and white streetcars during a heavy snowfall.
  The scene is rendered with thick, textured brushstrokes and shows colorful buildings in the
  background.]
* [Detail of a traditional Chinese handscroll painting titled "Old Pine Tree" by Ming dynasty artist
  Wen Zhengming, depicting a gnarled and vine-entangled tree in expressive monochrome ink. The long
  composition is annotated with vertical calligraphy and multiple red artist seals on the left.]
* [Detail of a black and white photograph by Chris Steele-Perkins depicting American civil rights
  activist Jesse Jackson during a 1990 visit to Soweto, South Africa. Jackson is surrounded by a
  dense press scrum of journalists, cameras, and microphones against a backdrop of anti-apartheid
  signage.]
* [Detail of a wide Impressionist painting by Claude Monet of his water lily pond at Giverny. The
  composition features clusters of pale water lilies floating on a shimmering surface of deep
  purples, blues, and greens, rendered with soft, blended brushstrokes and no visible horizon.]
Indian, A Brahmin gives Krishna the Message or Invitation for the Competition to Rukmini’s
Svayamvara, from a Bhagavata Purana, c.1650-60, Part of Open: The Cleveland Museum of Art, Creative
Commons: Free Reuse (CC0). Part of Open: The Cleveland Museum of Art.

# Welcome to **EverybodyWiki** !

## What is EverybodyWiki ?


[Create an account][61]

**EverybodyWiki** is an inclusionist online encyclopedia.
Create your own page or that of your company, about a video game or a movie... Anyone can write
about anything !

Become famous and gain notoriety by creating your biography !

[Register][62] and start contribute !

Already member ? [Log In][63]

## 🎯 What do we do ?
* Everybodywiki tries to **save articles which are currently marked for deletion on
  [Wikipedia][64]**.

We have many of the same features, such as [VisualEditor][65] and we are optimized for viewing from
mobile devices.
* An article on Everybodywiki **does not need any requirements** like to meet any standards of
  notability, arbitrary requirements, or be famous to be preserved.

Join the 👤**1,055** active contributors and create your article among 📰**616,292** other articles
in this wiki !

[Create an account][61] **EverybodyWiki** is an inclusionist online encyclopedia. Create your own page or that of your company, about a video game or a movie... Anyone can write about anything ! Become famous and gain notoriety by creating your biography ! [Register][62] and start contribute ! Already member ? [Log In][63] ## 🎯 What do we do ? * Everybodywiki tries to **save articles which are currently marked for deletion on [Wikipedia][64]**. We have many of the same features, such as [VisualEditor][65] and we are optimized for viewing from mobile devices. * An article on Everybodywiki **does not need any requirements** like to meet any standards of notability, arbitrary requirements, or be famous to be preserved. ## Over 20 Years of Fighting for Mesothelioma Patients

Our team at Mesothelioma.net will help you fight mesothelioma NOW by providing vital information on
the latest treatments, how to survive mesothelioma, and the best ways to obtain financial
assistance.

[FREE Mesothelioma Packet][65]

## How Can We Help You Today?

### Mesothelioma Overview

Learn about the symptoms, causes, and treatment of this rare cancer – and what you can do to improve
your life expectancy. We would be happy to help you with any questions you have at this difficult
time.

[Learn More About Mesothelioma][66]

### Surviving Mesothelioma

We will match you with world-renowned doctors and mesothelioma and asbestos specialists so you get

# Paper Chef

# BETTER WITH PREMIUM PARCHMENT PAPER

## Why Parchment?

It’s easy and fun to fit PaperChef parchment paper to your style of cooking. From baking to frying,
roasting, and even cleaning, the possibilities are endless with PaperChef. And it’s as friendly to
flavor as it is to the environment—you can eat up and clean up better with premium parchment paper.

**Ready to roll it out?**

[MORE VIDEOS][12]

## Sustainable and Versatile

Our parchment paper is the environmentally friendly way to cook because it’s compostable and made
from responsibly sourced Forest Stewardship Council® certified paper. Even the box is recyclable.

PaperChef parchment paper can do more than transform any cooking vessel into the perfect, non-stick,
flavor-protecting surface—use it to wipe down countertops, paint, gift wrap, and so much more. Your
home is always better with parchment paper.  

## Our Products

Discover what’s possible with parchment paper.

From preparation to presentation and everything in between, PaperChef paper products bring
versatility and convenience to your kitchen. Whether you’re baking, steaming, or storing, enjoy a
professional touch with ease.

PaperChef baking cups make every day a little special. Whether you are making a sweet treat or an
on-the-go breakfast, these baking cups make life a little easier and more fun!

fish—just fill and cook. Nonstick, food-safe, and mess-free, ideal for the oven or microwave. Great
for easy prep and cleanup.

Learn More

designed cups offer both style and function, ensuring the perfect presentation while keeping your
treats fresh.

Learn More

Wrap, grill, and serve with style. Our pink butcher paper is perfect for smoking, grilling, and
wrapping meats, offering breathability while keeping flavors in.

Prep, store, and serve with ease. PaperChef’s Wax Paper offers a non-stick, moisture-resistant
surface that’s perfect for wrapping, lining, and cooking. Microwave safe and versatile.

## Freezer Paper

Preserve, protect, and store with ease. PaperChef’s Freezer paper keeps your food fresh and
flavorful, providing a strong, moisture-resistant barrier that’s perfect for long-term storage.

Learn More

## Parchment Lotus Cups

Add a touch of elegance to every creation. From cupcakes to muffins, these beautifully designed cups
combine style and function, ensuring perfect presentation while keeping your treats fresh.

Learn More

## Parchment Sheets

Skip the trimming and enjoy a flawless fit every time. Designed to fit half-sheet pans unfolded or
quarter-sheet pans folded, these pre-cut parchment sheets make prep, baking, and cleanup effortless.
Professional convenience made simple.

Learn More

# Modern software.
# Built to perform.

PaperMC improves Minecraft's ecosystem with fast, secure software and an expanding plugin API,
providing quick releases and helpful support as the most widely used, performant, and stable
software available.

[ Downloads ][11][ Documentation ][12]
$

## Your server deserves the best.

[

### Paper

Paper is a Minecraft game server based on Spigot, designed to greatly improve performance and offer
more advanced features and API.

][13][

### Velocity

Velocity is a high-performance, scalable Minecraft proxy server that allows players to connect to
multiple Minecraft servers under the proxy.

][14][

### Folia

Folia is a new fork of Paper that adds regionized multithreading to the server allowing for better
performance and scalability.

][15]

## A diverse plugin ecosystem

Crafted by the PaperMC team & contributors, Hangar is our own dedicated plugin repository, now in
open beta! A place for developers to host their creations, and server owners to enrich their
player's gameplay. From Administration Tools, to Minigames, you'll find it all on Hangar.

[ Check out Hangar ][16]

## Powering players

PaperMC's software powers hundreds of thousands of Minecraft servers on a daily basis, from small
single-servers setups to massive Minecraft server networks. Designed with utility and performance in
mind, it can handle whatever you throw at it.

## The promise of stability

Our software is designed with security and stability in mind. We have consistently been among the
first to fix vulnerabilities in the Minecraft space for years, so you can rest assured that PaperMC
software is a good choice.

# Modern software.
# Built to perform.

PaperMC improves Minecraft's ecosystem with fast, secure software and an expanding plugin API,
providing quick releases and helpful support as the most widely used, performant, and stable
software available.

[ Downloads ][11][ Documentation ][12]
$

## Your server deserves the best.

[

### Paper

Paper is a Minecraft game server based on Spigot, designed to greatly improve performance and offer
more advanced features and API.

][13][

### Velocity

Velocity is a high-performance, scalable Minecraft proxy server that allows players to connect to
multiple Minecraft servers under the proxy.

][14][

### Folia

Folia is a new fork of Paper that adds regionized multithreading to the server allowing for better
performance and scalability.

][15]

## A diverse plugin ecosystem

Crafted by the PaperMC team & contributors, Hangar is our own dedicated plugin repository, now in
open beta! A place for developers to host their creations, and server owners to enrich their
player's gameplay. From Administration Tools, to Minigames, you'll find it all on Hangar.

[ Check out Hangar ][16]

## Powering players

PaperMC's software powers hundreds of thousands of Minecraft servers on a daily basis, from small
single-servers setups to massive Minecraft server networks. Designed with utility and performance in
mind, it can handle whatever you throw at it.

## The promise of stability

Our software is designed with security and stability in mind. We have consistently been among the
first to fix vulnerabilities in the Minecraft space for years, so you can rest assured that PaperMC
software is a good choice.

## Renewable Carbon by nova-Institute

Welcome to www.renewable-carbon.eu, the website showcasing nova-Institute’s many services around
renewable carbon: the bio- and CO2-based economy as well as chemical recycling. nova-Institute is a
science-based research and consultancy company. Organiser of leading expert conferences, workshops
and webinars.

[Subscribe]

### Renewable Carbon Newsletters

Stay informed about the latest developments in the renewable carbon industry and nova-Institute’s
activities. Choose the news relevant to your business out of 19 different topics: sustainability –
renewable carbon – recycling – policy – pharma – natural fibres – food – engineering – energy –
digital and artificial intelligence – carbon, capture and utilization – bio-based materials –
plastics and composites – bio-based chemicals and industrial biotechnology – automotive –
agriculture, forestry and resources – nova’s monthly newsletter – Renewable Carbon Newsletter –
Press releases – events and conferences.

[**https://renewable-carbon.eu/newsletters**][38]

[Businesses Directory]

### ReCaCo – International Directory for Renewable Materials

The leading business directory for the bio-based, CO2-based and recycled materials gives you the
opportunity to look up suppliers, partners and service providers or present your own company and
products to the right audience for you.

[https://renewable-carbon.eu/companies/][39]

[nova-Institute]

### nova-Institute

nova-Institut GmbH has been working in the field of sustainability since the mid-1990s and today
focuses primarily on the areas of circular economy, bioeconomy and CO2 utilisation. 

The independent company supports the chemical and plastics industries in the transition from fossil
to renewable carbon – based on biomass, CO2 utilisation or recycling – through research and
science-based consulting. 

Both in accompanying research for innovation projects and in individual business consulting, nova’s
interdisciplinary team covers the entire value chain. It works on all topics from raw materials,
technology scouting and market research to economics, policy, life cycle assessments and
sustainability, as well as support in communication and strategy development.
50 experts from different fields work together to defossilise the industry and create a
climate-neutral future.

[**www.nova-institute.eu**][40]

[21 01 07 RC Diamanten Menu Renewable Carbon]

### Renewable Carbon

What is renewable carbon?

Renewable Carbon entails all carbon sources that avoid or substitute the use of any additional
fossil carbon from the geosphere. Renewable carbon can come from the biosphere, atmosphere or
technosphere – but not from the geosphere. Renewable carbon circulates between biosphere, atmosphere
or technosphere, creating a carbon circular economy.

How does it differ from the bioeconomy and circular economy? This page provides a definition and
background on the renewable carbon strategy and why it is relevant to you.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/info**][41]

[21 01 07 RC Diamanten Menu Events]

### Renewable Carbon Events

nova-Institute hosts workshops and conferences, big and small, for an expert audience. Some related
to our research projects, some as stand-alone events. Most notable the Renewable Materials
Conference ([www.renewable-materials.eu][42]), International Conference on Cellulose Fibres
([www.cellulose-fibres.eu][43]), Conference on CO2-based Fuels and Chemicals
([www.co2-chemistry.eu][44]) and the nova Sessions, a series of workshops on pressing political
issues and market developments. On this website, you can find all upcoming events.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/events**][45]

[21 01 07 RC Diamanten Menu Publications]

### Renewable Carbon Publications

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/publications**][46]

[21 01 07 RC Diamanten Menu Graphics]

### Renewable Carbon Graphics

We firmly believe in making knowledge accessible: not only do we offer free reports to spread
knowledge on renewable carbon-related topics, but we also supplement the written word with
attractive graphics.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/graphics**][47]

[21 01 07 RC Diamanten Menu News]

### Renewable Carbon News

Relevant press releases, interviews and general news keep you informed about the latest innovations,
inventions, investments and developments in bioeconomy, industrial biotechnology, bio-based
chemistry and materials, CO2-based materials, Carbon Capture & Utilisation (CCU) and Power-to-X
industries as well as chemical recycling. Keep up easily with the latest research and market
developments by subscribing to the daily newsletter, Twitter account or RSS feed.

### Don't Miss This Tour of Atlanta!

#### February 2022

We are two old college roommates who were lucky enough to spend a half day taking the Black History
& Civil Rights Tour with Omar. The tour was all-encompassing, packed full with history, Atlanta
information, video aids, and an excellent narrative. Omar is so knowledgeable and professional, and
it was obvious he loves what he’s doing. Thank you!

[Read more][76]

### Fantastic tour

#### January 2022

Our tour guide Omar was excellent. It was a very cold day in Atlanta, and he could have canceled the
tour as we were the only ones on it. He gave us the full experience and told us tons of history you
could never get in the books. Highly recommend!

### If You Don’t Do Anything In Atlanta Take This Tour.

#### January 2022

If you are coming to Atlanta to visit, have a layover and need to time or if you have been living
here you need to do this tour, I absolutely loved it our tour guide was Amazing! He was
knowledgeable, courteous and fun! We literally hit everything there was to see in Atlanta and we
learned so much rich history about this beautiful city. I also learned about some more places to go
when I come back.:) I’m leaving for home tomorrow and it definitely was the icing on my cake to my
wonderful trip., Again TAKE THIS TOUR.

## Deliverables That Drive Revenue Decisions

Research outputs designed to plug directly into planning, investment and board level discussions.

### From Insight to Implementation

#### Data Collection

Structured gathering of market, customer, financial and competitive data from primary and secondary
sources.

#### Analytics and Modelling

indicators.

#### Insight Development

Senior analysts translate findings into clear storylines and strategic implications.

#### Actionable Deliverables

Concrete recommendations, prioritised actions and quantified impact ranges.

#### Follow Through and Measurement

Support in defining KPIs and tracking how decisions influence revenue, margin and risk over time.

## Your Trusted Partner in Market and Revenue Intelligence

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping
organisations make better revenue decisions.

### Informed Strategic Planning

We give strategy, finance and business leaders a common, fact-based view of the markets they operate
in. This reduces debate about “what is true” and shifts the conversation to “what should we do
next”.

### Stronger Investment and Portfolio Choices

By linking market outlooks to product, geography and customer portfolios, we help you decide where
to expand, where to hold and where to exit. The result is sharper focus and better use of capital.

### Faster, More Confident Execution

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams, secure stakeholder
buy in and move at speed. Our team remains available beyond the report handover to test assumptions
and refine plans.

Our consultants are ready to support your next strategy cycle, investment decision or market entry
initiative with clear, evidence based insight.

Our consultants are ready to help craft a future-focused, resilient, and innovative packaging
strategy tailored to your needs.

Connect with us through [www.strategicrevenueinsights.com][54] to discover how we can support your

# What Is The Candida Diet?

The **Candida diet** is a low-sugar, anti-inflammatory diet that promotes good gut health and
eliminates the sugars that feed a Candida overgrowth. The diet includes non-starchy vegetables, some
low sugar fruits, non-glutenous grains, some dairy products, and fermented foods.

By improving your gut health, and restoring the balance of the bacteria and yeast that live inside
your body, you can get relief from Candida symptoms like bloating, indigestion, yeast infections,
fatigue, nausea, diarrhea, and gas. ([1][38])

**One of the major causes of gut dysbiosis and fungal overgrowth is a diet full of sugary,
processed, junk foods.** These foods are high in sugars that feed a Candida overgrowth, and rich in
pro-inflammatory ingredients that damage your gut and cause inflammation across your body. ([2][39])

The importance of the gut microbiome has been proven time and time again. There are an incredible 40
trillion microorganisms living in your body. In fact, you have more of these microorganisms inside
you than you have human cells! ([3][40])

different factors can change this - for example, a high-sugar diet, a course of antibiotics, or
chronic stress.

flora in your gut.

your immune system really well, creating biofilms to protect itself. Secondly, it can convert back
and forth from its fungal form as conditions in your gut change. And thirdly, it can change the pH
of its surroundings to enable it to switch to its pathogen form. ([15][60], [16][61], [17][62])

foot, oral thrush, diaper rash, and nail fungus. These skin infections are often related to an
intestinal Candida overgrowth in the gut.

allergies, yeast infections, mild depression, joint pain, and much more.

acetaldehyde.

the International Agency for Research on Cancer. Uric acid can cause joint pain and lead to gout if
an excess builds up.

diet, most importantly by removing all added sugars, is the first step. Taking [a good
probiotic][69] will crowd out the Candida yeast and start to heal your gut. And [some natural
antifungals][70] will help to reverse the Candida overgrowth.

## Premium Parchment Paper & Custom Cutting

WIDE RANGE OF GRADE AND INVENTORY | CUT-TO-SIZE SHEETS AND CIRLES ANY GRADE

[Request Custom Quote][25]

## Shop Catalog

[View All][26]

### Baking Parchment Paper

We manufacturer and master distributor a variety of paper products. We distribute parchment paper in
a variety of sizes and shapes. 

Baking parchment paper is made to resist high cooking temperatures, oil and water immersion. We can
provide you with specialty food grade papers with basis weights 25lb, 27lb, and 35lb range.

Parchment paper can be treated with silicone or quilon for non-stick applications. We also carry
*Genuine Vegetable Parchment* (GVP) in many sizes.

Parchment is used for wrapping foods during cooking, such as fish, and as a bottom sheet for
products such as baked goods and pizza. Parchment paper can also be great for Freeze Dryer Tray,
Vacuum Oven, wax paper, rosin extraction, and other concentrated oils.

## Why Worthy Liners

### Paper Cutting Services

At Worthy Liners, We specialize in custom converting parchment paper to any variety of sizes and
shapes. Our Parchment paper is treated with silicone or quilon for non-stick applications.

### Fast Delivery Time

Quick turn around time. Most orders placed online will arrive within 2 to 6 business days. Larger
Palletized orders ships via LTL Freight Carriers.

### Great Customer Service

MADE IN USA. We pride ourselves on going beyond our customer's expectations to offer the best. We
build relationships based upon trust, commitment, and dedication. We are always customer focused and
will deliver what the customer needs.
